notes.title: Sausage Fest - Officially Released
notes.notes: Hi everyone, as you may have noticed, we officially released Sausage Fest. I added a new patch recently as well to fix any server issues that users may encounter so feel free to let me know if any issues occur. We also added Turkey as a region. The game is fully playable and has enough content for a full release but we will continue to add more content that you may suggest on our Discord server. All information on where to contact us is on [url=https://sausagefestgame.com]our site.[/url]

notes.title: Early Access Build v0.3e
notes.notes:
In v0.3e, we've added the following major features:
[list]
[*]Kill The King (New Game Mode) - In [i]Kill The King[/i], you start off with a single king and many peasants.   Peasants must work together to dethrone the king, with the killer taking their place. Peasants can only kill the king to gain points and take their place, but cannot kill each other. However, as the king, you can kill all the peasants to gain points and keep your title as king. The player with the most points wins. This game mode is essentially a [i]1vAll Team Deathmatch[/i] mode where killing the target causes you to become the target, but gives you the opportunity to gain more points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092491/b3d6db51cfdc0b7b91a61484dc33d253f092f2cf.png[/img]
[*] macOS Support - Sausage Fest is now available on macOS! We are now officially supporting both Windows and macOS.
[/list]

These are some major updates to Sausage Fest for v0.3e for the month of September. Please visit our [url=https://discord.gg/EfudnDh]Discord[/url] if you wish to give your feedback on the game. The next Major Update is planned to be in October. These updates will bring more content to the Early Access Builds. All updates will be announced on both Steam and our Discord Server.

notes.title: Early Access Build v0.2e
notes.notes:
In v0.2e, we've made some minor changes to improve the experience of the game. We have added the following things:
[list]
[*]A Camera Lock System - The new update features a camera lock system that allows you to toggle between locking your character to the center of the screen or being able to move the camera around. You can toggle this option in-game by pressing the [i]Y Key[/i] (100% Original). We have enabled this by default to make navigation easier for newer players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092491/3e79bc217c6294dbfd00a6f4281de29c21f42891.png[/img]
[*]Info on Drops - You can press the [i]view drops[/i] button in the Drops menu when in a room to view all the drops in the game. Players will also see what each drop does when picked up in-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092491/a4c0ee8ec53fefebea68ef40f9401c289b4b4e06.png[/img]
[/list]

These are minor updates to Sausage Fest for v0.2e that were requested by some of our players. Please visit our [url=https://discord.gg/EfudnDh]Discord[/url] if you also wish to give your feedback on the game. Major updates are planned to be once a month, these updates will bring more content to the Early Access Builds. All updates will be announced on both Steam and our Discord Server.

notes.title: The Sausage Fest Community
notes.notes:
As we start our journey of publishing Sausage Fest, we would like to begin by letting you know how you can join us in the development process. Our main platforms for discussion on the game is through our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1315660/]Steam Community Hub[/url] and our[url=https://discord.gg/EfudnDh] Discord server.[/url] All links to our social media platforms can be found on our [url=https://sausagefestgame.com]website.[/url] You can ask us questions about the game itself, development status and even make suggestions as we develop the game. We will make announcements on Steam and our Discord server frequently to make sure everyone is up to date on any new information regarding the development of the game. Joining discussions, wishlisting the game and sharing it with friends helps us out a lot, so feel free let us know your thoughts or any questions regarding the game.
